title: Text limits are UTF-8 bytes, one below the documented character counts
claim: The display page gives text limits in characters: 64 per list item, and 1,000 per text container on create or rebuild. The docs changelog gives them in bytes: simulator 0.7.1 adds a 999-byte text container limit as a firmware-matching fix, and simulator 0.7.3 caps list items at 63 bytes.
actual: The caps count UTF-8 bytes. A report from analysis of stock firmware 2.2.6.10 finds the text buffers hold 999 bytes on create and 1,999 bytes on a text update, against 1,000 and 2,000 characters in the docs. Korean, Chinese and Japanese take 3 bytes per character, so a text container holds 333 of them, not 1,000, and a list item 21, not 64.
impact: Text sized by character count can run past the cap. Non-Latin text reaches it at about a third of the documented length.
workaround: Count UTF-8 bytes (new TextEncoder().encode(text).length): at most 999 per text container, 1,999 per text update and 63 per list item.

evidence.note: From the firmware's char[1000] and char[2000] text buffers. Covers text containers, not list items.
